author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Lossy Links Ring v0.2: Tuned floors and gentler adjustments
abstract: Tuned adaptive control for lossy uni/bidir rings: higher rate floor and start (0.6), gentler adjustment (1.2), and explicit delivery/coverage targets. Runs N=24 at reliabilities 0.8 and 0.9 with 20 replicates, aggregating time_to_full and deliveries/step.
